lernapps.github.io.message:
revert(nav): no tooling entry in the top-level navigation; keep /tooling/ a known site

## Intent

The link to the tooling belongs in the body of the build page, not in the navigation of every site.

## Key changes

- The "Bauhilfen" entry is gone from the top-level navigation.
- /tooling/ stays a known site of the shared frame, so links to it still resolve.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The build page of apps links the tooling instead (18b65da, same intent).

apps.message:
feat(build): link the tooling home page in the body of App bauen

## Intent

Builders should learn what lernapps provides to build easier and faster, right on the page where building starts.

## Key changes

- A new section on the build page, between "Tell your assistant" and "What happens next": "Was lernapps.net dir zum Bauen bereitstellt" (in English "What lernapps.net provides for you to build"), with a short text and a button to /tooling/.
- The German button says "Zu den Bauhilfen (auf Englisch)", because the tooling site is English only.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The navigation entry of lernapps.github.io is removed in the same intent (831d96c).
